summary: No advisory committee was convened for the original approval of Rubraca (NDA209115). The Multi-Disciplinary Review states the Division did not obtain ODAC advice because no safety or efficacy issues required outside advice, and the Risk Review notes there was no plan to hold an Advisory Committee meeting. Consequently there are no AdComm-driven linkages to any changes in the approval.
